target: AMFI category monthly net flow in INR crore
supplemental_horizon: 4 supports the next three full calendar months plus the next-release nowcast
selection_metric: mean absolute error divided by the forecast-origin AUM, averaged equally across category and primary horizon
selection_rule: choose one global candidate on development targets only; freeze that name before scoring final test targets
macro_missing: never zero-fill; carry latest earlier observed value with age and missing indicators
macro_vintage_limit: latest available historical handbook values are not original-release vintages

intervals.method: rolling signed forecast errors normalized by their origin AUM, recentered at their median
intervals.eligibility: forecast target month must be no later than the current known-AMFI origin month
intervals.guarantee: coverage is measured out of sample and is not guaranteed

policy.baseline: max(0, actual net outflow for the same calendar month last year)
policy.literal_cost: annual_gap * days/365 * max(buffer - realized_positive_net_outflow, 0) + penalty * max(realized_positive_net_outflow - buffer, 0)
policy.constraint: buffer capped at known origin AUM; uncapped recommendation is also retained
policy.note: the brief's 3x penalty is read as 3 rupees per rupee of shortfall; a yield-gap reading is reported as a sensitivity

prohibited: calibration residuals whose targets are not yet known
model selection on final test results
point_forecast_postprocessing: rolling signed-error median bias correction for every candidate; uncorrected seasonal naive is separately reported
